section_media.label: Hero
section_media.prompt: A vast dark void with slow-drifting particles of violet and electric-blue light, faint volumetric beams from above, a glossy black floor with soft neon reflections, low fog rolling along the floor, camera pushing forward very slowly.

section_media.label: Manifesto
section_media.prompt: Hundreds of translucent film frames drifting through dark space in slow motion, most dim and out of focus; one frame in the centre sharpens and glows violet as the camera slowly dollies toward it.

section_media.label: Premium intro (2 s card)
section_media.prompt: An empty dark cinema seen from the back row, a projector beam cutting through haze in violet and blue light, dust floating in the beam, the screen glowing soft white.

section_media.label: Two Crafts: AI
section_media.prompt: A surreal landscape forming out of liquid light, neon violet and blue geometry melting and re-forming like a fluid simulation, dreamlike and slow.

section_media.label: Two Crafts: Editing
section_media.prompt: Extreme close-up of an editing timeline on a dark monitor, clips sliding into place and a magenta playhead scrubbing across, very shallow depth of field so the interface is soft bokeh.

section_media.label: Work Library
section_media.prompt: A slow tracking shot along a wall of glowing screens in a dark room, each playing abstract colourful motion, reflections on a glossy floor.

section_media.label: Process
section_media.prompt: A single beam of violet light travelling along a dark horizontal track, passing through glass blocks that light up one after another, blue and magenta refractions, slow sideways camera move.

section_media.label: Toolkit
section_media.prompt: Chrome and glass objects (a camera lens, a film reel, a glowing cube) slowly rotating in a dark studio with neon rim light, product-shot style.

section_media.label: Proof
section_media.prompt: A crowd in silhouette lit only by the glow of phone screens in violet and blue, slow motion, shallow focus, no faces visible.

section_media.label: Service: AI ad (3 s, 4:5)
section_media.prompt: Liquid chrome morphing into a sleek product shape.

section_media.label: Service: Music (3 s, 4:5)
section_media.prompt: Neon stage lights pulsing through smoke.

section_media.label: Service: Social (3 s, 4:5)
section_media.prompt: Vertical phone screens stacked in 3D space, scrolling.

section_media.label: Service: Long-form (3 s, 4:5)
section_media.prompt: A dark corridor of film strips gliding past the camera.

section_media.label: Finale
section_media.prompt: Violet and blue light rising slowly over a reflective black floor with rolling fog, the centre of frame kept empty and dark, camera craning up slowly.

faqs.question: Who owns the final video?
faqs.answer: You do. You get full commercial rights to the final delivered files.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Most short pieces take TODO days from approved brief to delivery.

faqs.question: Can you work with footage I already have?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send it in any format and I'll mix it with generated shots where it helps.

faqs.question: How many revisions are included?
faqs.answer: TODO rounds of revisions are included in every project.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Message me on WhatsApp or email with your idea and deadline. I'll reply with questions and a quote.
